how.title: How it works
how.standfirst: Five moves, then the published pathway the product follows.
how.diagramLabel: Premarital screening pathway, nine states in order
how.branchBody: When a shared result is found, both partners meet a physician together, after the person concerned agrees, and are referred to a specialist for a management plan. The programme tracks a 90 percent referral target.
how.simBody: Every state change and timestamp in the demo is simulated. Rishta Safe has no connection to any health service, laboratory or registry.
how.sourceBody: Published standards of the Department of Health Abu Dhabi (version 3, September 2024) and the Dubai Health Authority (version 1, effective 27 March 2026). Times differ between sources and are parameters here.

time.sample_collection: About 15 minutes, in the same visit
time.lab_processing: Standard tests about 24 hours; genetic panel about 2 to 4 weeks

detail.registration_consent: The couple book a visit, bring their documents, and sign the information and consent forms.
detail.physician_consult: A physician meets each partner separately and reviews the history, including family history.
detail.sample_collection: Blood is taken for the standard tests and the genetic panel in the same visit.
detail.lab_processing: A licensed laboratory runs the tests and returns an interpreted report.
detail.joint_report: A single joint report is produced. It states only whether a shared result was found, without gene or variant detail.
detail.counselling: Where a shared result is found, partners are contacted separately first, then counselled together once the person concerned agrees.
detail.declaration: The couple sign a declaration that they were informed of their results.
detail.certificate: A certificate is issued, valid for three months and only for the named partners.
detail.judicial_handoff: The report goes to the judicial authority. The decision to marry belongs to the judicial authorities, not to the clinic and not to Rishta Safe.

threshold.title: The threshold
threshold.body: Nothing opens until each person chooses how to meet it. A refusal is recorded as a right.

together.body: The result in both partners' languages side by side, with a tally of 100 pregnancies.

sharing.body: Each person decides what the partner sees. The law fixes the rest. Every change writes an audit row.

how.pathwayNote: Times come from the published standards and are parameters in this prototype, not promises.

gov.title: Clause register and limits
gov.standfirst: Each clause of the law the product relies on, where it shows up in Rishta Safe, the endpoint behind it, and how to try it.

declData.title: All data is synthetic
declData.body: Every person, result, consent and record in this prototype is made up. Couples are generated by gene-dropping through defined pedigrees. No real patient, name, identity number, hospital record or laboratory report was used or is stored.

declText.title: Where the words come from
declText.body: Explanations come from reviewed templates and a glossary. A cloud language model may have helped draft static template wording while it was being written; no personal or realistic couple data was ever sent to it.

declNoLlm.title: No model at run time
declNoLlm.body: Nothing a user types is sent to a language model, and no model writes a result. A deterministic checker verifies numbers and polarity and enforces a banned-word list in all three languages.

declLicences.title: Licences
declLicences.body: We ship no third-party content that cannot be used commercially. Facts with a citation may be quoted; restricted tables are not copied. Standard questionnaire instruments are not used: the eight comprehension items are original.

adapters.body: Every connection to Emirates Health Services, Malaffi, the Emirati Genome Programme, DoH Abu Dhabi and DHA Dubai is simulated and labelled so. Rishta Safe does not integrate with any of them.

data.body: Couples, results, consents, audit events and pathway times are synthetic and can be reset.

translation.body: Arabic and Urdu text are machine-drafted translations, awaiting native clinical review.

rules.body: Every clinical rule, cut-off and detection rate carries a source or is marked illustrative, and is pending sign-off by the clinical lead (sign-off pending). Nothing here has been clinically reviewed.

limits.1: This is education and decision support. It is not a diagnosis, not clinical advice and not a medical device.
limits.2: No clinical review, field validation or real patient data stands behind it.
limits.3: A result describes one test panel. No panel detects every inherited condition, and the detection rates shown are assumptions with a source or are marked illustrative.
limits.4: For partners who are related, a negative test reassures less than it does for unrelated partners, because missed changes are shared through common ancestors. Rishta Safe says so and does not show a residual-risk number.
limits.5: A couple sees only three result labels: shared result found, no shared change found, more information needed. There is no score, no points total and no question about a marriage decision.
limits.6: Under Decree-Law 49/2023 the state is a statutory recipient of screening data (Art. 26(2)). Rishta Safe never claims to hide data from the state. Sharing between partners and for other purposes is consent-based.

gov.priorTitle: What Rishta Safe claims and does not claim

standards.title: Primary standards
standards.body: The pathway follows the DoH Abu Dhabi premarital standard (version 3, September 2024) and the DHA Dubai standard (version 1, effective 27 March 2026): forms, tests, counselling, turnaround, single joint report, signed declaration, certificate and judicial hand-off.

claims.title: Claims and non-claims
claims.body: Rishta Safe claims one thing: a way to explain a screening result in each partner's language and to keep each person's choices on record, built and tested on synthetic data. It does not claim clinical validity, a new test, a validated translation or any clinical review. Every figure it reports states what it does not show.

reg.1: Rishta Safe is a prototype of an education and decision-support companion. It is not registered or assessed as a medical device and makes no clinical claim.
reg.2: Decree-Law 49/2023: each person may request their own results (Art. 9(1)) and may choose not to know (Art. 9(2)); employers and insurers may not require or use results (Art. 19 to 21); no ancestry or lineage is inferred (Art. 9); programme statistics are not published (Art. 25(3)).
reg.3: Screening for couples who plan to marry is mandatory and is not consent-based (Art. 4(2)(a), 15). The decision to marry belongs to the judicial authorities, not to this product.

sharing.label: Who sees what
sharing.title: Each person decides what the partner sees. The law decides the rest.
sharing.body: Every cell comes from the consent ledger and the emirate's disclosure rule, and every change you make writes a row to a hash-chained audit log.
sharing.caption: Who sees what
sharing.fine: Employers and insurers may not require or use results: Federal Decree-Law 49/2023, Art. 19 to 21. Rishta Safe never claims to hide data from the health authorities.
